#ifndef __if_h
  #define __if_h

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN
    #ifdef __ILEC400__
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern "C"
    #endif

    #define __QBFC_EXTERN
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/socket.h>               /* sockaddr structure          */
#include <sys/types.h>                /* common typedefs             */
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)  /* @B1A*/
#pragma datamodel(P128)      /* @B1A*/
#endif                       /* @B1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Miscellaneous macros                                              */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IFNAMSIZ          16          /* maximum interface name size */
#define IFLINSIZ          10          /* maximum line description
                                         name                        */
#define IFLINVLANSIZ      16          /* maximum line description  @A5A
                                         name including vlan id      */
#define IF_NAMESIZE       IFNAMSIZ    /* max interface name size @A3A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for ifru_flags field in ifreq structure                    */
/* and ifa_flags field in ifaddrs structure                      @A3A*/
/*********************************************************************/

#define IFF_ALLMULTI      0x0001      /* receive all multicast packet*/
#define IFF_BRIDGE        0x0002      /* token-ring routing supported*/
#define IFF_BROADCAST     0x0004      /* IP broadcast address valid  */
#define IFF_COMPAC        0x0008      /* compress PPP address/control*/
#define IFF_COMPPROT      0x0010      /* compress PPP protocol       */
#define IFF_DEBUG         0x0020      /* activate interface debugging*/
#define IFF_LOOPBACK      0x0040      /* loopback network interface  */
#define IFF_NOARP         0x0080      /* ARP not supported           */
#define IFF_NOTRAILERS    0x0100      /* do not use trailers         */
#define IFF_PROMISC       0x0200      /* receive all packets         */
#define IFF_POINTOPOINT   0x0400      /* interface is point-to-point
                                         link                        */
#define IFF_RUNNING       0x0800      /* resources allocated and
                                         running                     */
#define IFF_SNAP          0x1000      /* extended SAP header
                                         supported                   */
#define IFF_UP            0x2000      /* logical interfaces up and
                                         active                      */
#define IFF_MULTICAST     0x4000      /* supports IP multicast   @A1A*/

#define IFF_UNNUMBERED    0x8000      /* non-unique address      @A3A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* ifru_flags field is only 16 bits so ioctl() can not return any of */
/* the following flags. They will only be returned on getifaddrs()   */
/*********************************************************************/
#define IFF_DEPRECATED    0x00010000  /* interface address
                                         deprecated              @A3A*/
#define IFF_ADDRCONF      0x00020000  /* address from stateless
                                         addrconf                @A3A*/
#define IFF_NONUD         0x00040000  /* Neighbor Unreachable
                                         Detected not supported  @A3A*/
#define IFF_ANYCAST       0x00080000  /* supports IP anycast     @A3A*/
#define IFF_TEMPORARY     0x00100000  /* temporary addr (RFC3041)@A3A*/
#define IFF_VIRTUALIP     0x00200000  /* indicates a VIPA        @A3A*/
#define IFF_DHCPRUNNING   0x00400000  /* indicates a DHCP client @A4A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to simplify access to ifc_ifcu union in ifconf structure   */
/*********************************************************************/

#define ifc_buf         ifc_ifcu.ifcu_buf
#define ifc_req         ifc_ifcu.ifcu_req

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to simplify access to ifr_ifru union in ifreq structure    */
/*********************************************************************/

#define ifr_addr        ifr_ifru.ifru_addr
#define ifr_mask        ifr_ifru.ifru_mask
#define ifr_broadaddr   ifr_ifru.ifru_broadaddr
#define ifr_flags       ifr_ifru.ifru_flags
#define ifr_mtu         ifr_ifru.ifru_mtu
#define ifr_rbufsize    ifr_ifru.ifru_rbufsize
#define ifr_linename    ifr_ifru.ifru_linename
#define ifr_TOS         ifr_ifru.ifru_TOS

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct ifreq {                        /* interface entry request     */

  char ifr_name[IFNAMSIZ];            /* interface name              */
  union {
     struct sockaddr ifru_addr;       /* local IP address            */
     struct sockaddr ifru_mask;       /* subnetwork mask             */
     struct sockaddr ifru_broadaddr;  /* broadcast address           */
     short  ifru_flags;               /* interface flags             */
     int    ifru_mtu;                 /* interface MTU size          */
     int    ifru_rbufsize;            /* reassembly buffer size      */
     char   ifru_linename[IFLINVLANSIZ];/* line description name @A5C*/
     u_char ifru_TOS;                 /* type-of-service             */
  } ifr_ifru;

};

struct ifconf {                       /* interface configuration list*/

  int ifc_len;                        /* size of user-supplied buffer*/
  int ifc_configured;                 /* number of interfaces
                                         configured                  */
  int ifc_returned;                   /* number of interfaces
                                         returned                    */
  union {
     caddr_t      ifcu_buf;           /* user-supplied buffer address*/
     struct ifreq *ifcu_req;          /* returned list of interfaces */
  } ifc_ifcu;

};

struct if_nameindex {
  unsigned int if_index;                      /* 1, 2, ...               @A2A*/
  char *if_name;                              /* null terminated name    @A2A*/
};


/*********************************************************************/
/* Function prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

QBFC_EXTERN unsigned int if_nametoindex(const char *);                /* @A2A*/
QBFC_EXTERN char *if_indextoname(unsigned int, char *);               /* @A2A*/
QBFC_EXTERN struct if_nameindex *if_nameindex(void);                  /* @A2A*/
QBFC_EXTERN void   if_freenameindex(struct if_nameindex *);           /* @A2A*/

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)  /* @B1A*/
#pragma datamodel(pop)       /* @B1A*/
#endif                       /* @B1A*/
#endif /* __if_h */

#ifdef __cplusplus
    #pragma info(restore)
#else
    #pragma checkout(resume)
#endif
